body.name: Q_Ge
body.type: conditional finite family of certificate circuits
body.def: When \(d_e(G)<\infty\) and a valid \(\mathfrak C_{G,e}\) is supplied, \(\mathcal Q_{G,e}\) is the family of covariance-localization, incidence-lifting, pole, projective-leading-form, specialized-leading-coefficient, squarefreeness, and real-lifting circuits returned by \(\mathrm{thm:conditional\mbox{-}geometric\mbox{-}resolution}\).
